svg.title: Trained in simulation, deployed in reality
svg.desc: Diagram: a policy is trained in simulation, exported to ONNX, and deployed on the real robot; the sim-to-real step is the hard part. The method is documented and open, not independently tested here.

text.tspan: TRAINED IN SIMULATION, DEPLOYED IN REALITY
The learning happens in simulation. The robot has to live in the real world.
IN SIMULATION — where a policy is trained
ON THE REAL ROBOT — where the policy must work
The method is documented and the code is open.
Orange Tomato did not test a trained policy on a real robot.
